text: tassuddānaṃ natumhākena deva vuttā bhikkhūhi apare duve ānandena ca deva vuttā anudhammehi deva dukāti . _______________ #1 ma. yo . khandhasaṃyuttassa mūlapaṇṇāsake attadīpavaggo pañcamo [87] sāvatthiyaṃ . tatra kho . attadīpā bhikkhave viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā . attadīpānaṃ bhikkhave viharataṃ attasaraṇānaṃ anaññasaraṇānaṃ dhammadīpānaṃ dhammasaraṇānaṃ anaññasaraṇānaṃ yonisova 1 upaparikkhitabbo kiṃjātikā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā kiṃpahotikāti . kiṃjātikā ca bhikkhave sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā kiṃpahotikā . idha bhikkhave
